audience.text: i have an overdue book. 9 years

reply.line: Welcome to the stacks. Voices low, hands clean, and nobody feeds the serpents after midnight. We have a great deal of reading to get through.
A timeout is a statue with a reason. Spam in my stacks and you will spend ten minutes as a very quiet piece of stone. Shh. It is for your own good.
The left three say you are all being very loud. The right three say the left three are being dull. They are all correct, and none of them are helping.
Nine years. How lovely. The fine is one confession and the book itself, returned in the condition you borrowed it. Dust is acceptable. Teeth marks are not.
Every book in this room is waiting for someone to ask the right question. Most of you ask the wrong one, loudly. Try again, softly.
One more rule of the stacks: if the snakes go quiet, so do you. They have never once been wrong about who is about to type something foolish.
